en.name: Task Board
en.description: Kanban boards kept in Markdown: a list per heading, a card per task, in a .md with kanban-plugin in its front matter, as Obsidian's Kanban writes it.
en.needsFolder: Open a folder first: the board is kept in it.
en.tool.list_boards: Lists the Kanban boards (kanban-plugin .md files) in the open folder, each with its lists and how many cards each holds.
en.tool.read_board: Reads a Kanban board: its lists in order, each with its cards' text and whether each is done. Tasks written in ordinary documents are list_tasks.
en.tool.add_card: Adds a card to the end of a list on a Kanban board. Only for a board (kanban-plugin .md); a to-do in a document is add_task.
en.tool.move_card: Moves a card on a Kanban board to another list, or to another place in its own.

zh.tool.read_board: 读取一个看板：按顺序给出各个列表，以及每个列表里卡片的文字和是否已完成。普通文档里的任务用 list_tasks。
zh.tool.add_card: 在看板某个列表的末尾添加一张卡片。只用于看板（kanban-plugin .md）；文档里的待办用 add_task。
zh.tool.move_card: 把看板上的一张卡片移到另一个列表，或移到所在列表的另一个位置。
